% Design sketch, not yet a working fixture: the modernized Metropolis
% successor written as a token bundle, so the theme is reviewable as data
% rather than as adjectives. Values are invented for this repo.
%
% Commands marked PENDING are not implemented yet; the file is here to make
% the design concrete and to drive the M4/M5 grammar. It is excluded from the
% golden set until those land.
\documentclass[aspectratio=169]{slides}

\fonts{
  dir = "fonts",
  body = "Open Sans",
  sans = "Open Sans",
  mono = "Source Code Pro",
  math = "Fira Math",          % PENDING (M6): matched math face, never pasted-in CM
}

\palette{
  % Neither pure black nor pure white on either side: both are harsh on a
  % projector and on an OLED panel.
  surface   = #F7F6F2,         % warm off-white
  ink       = #22252A,         % near-black
  muted     = #626973,         % secondary text, captions, footer
  accent    = #B5442B,         % exactly one accent
  tint      = #EFEDE7,         % 2-4% plane separation, not a border
  rule      = #DCD8CF,         % hairlines
}

\palette[dark]{                % PENDING (M5b): variant, same accent, re-checked
  surface   = #1D2024,
  ink       = #F2F0EA,
  muted     = #A3A9B1,
  accent    = #E58A6E,         % lifted for AA on dark
  tint      = #2A2E33,
  rule      = #41464D,
}

% A ~1.25 modular scale. Body at 22pt reads from the back row of a lecture
% hall; Metropolis-era decks sat near 14pt and assumed a small room.
\tokens{
  body      = 22pt,
  small     = 17.6pt,          % body / 1.25
  large     = 27.5pt,          % body * 1.25
  title     = 43pt,            % body * 1.25^3
  beat      = 1.2em plus 0.3em minus 0.15em,
  gap       = 1.25 * beat,     % between blocks
  hold      = 0.5 * beat,      % a heading to what it heads
  gutter    = 0.06 * body,
  hairline  = 1.5pt,
}

\page{
  size    = a4paper,
  margin  = 0.055 * body,
}

% PENDING (M5): chrome. A hairline progress bar, section title and number in a
% quiet footer, and no logo repeated on every slide.
% \chrome{
%   progress = hairline,
%   footer   = { left = \sectiontitle, right = \slidenumber },
%   logo     = titleonly,
% }

% PENDING (M4b): theorem environments. An accent rule on the leading edge and
% a small-caps label, not a boxed colored panel.
% \theoremstyle{
%   rule    = { width = 2pt, color = accent },
%   label   = { variant = smallcaps, weight = medium },
%   body    = { surface = tint },
%   numbering = section,
%   qed     = tombstone,
% }

\assert{ fonts.all_embedded }

\begin{document}

\begin{frame}{What this theme is}
  \begin{itemize}
    \item<1-> One accent, two neutrals, and a tint for depth.
    \item<2-> Type large enough to read from the back row.
    \item<3-> Overlays dim rather than hide, so nothing reflows.
  \end{itemize}
\end{frame}

\end{document}
